{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm revenue is string with commas
print("Are there commas in the revenue column?")
print(sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any())

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any non-numeric values
print("Any non-numeric revenue after cleaning?")
print(sales['revenue_float'].isna().sum())

# Check status values
print("Status values:")
print(sales['status'].unique())

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if any completed orders have revenue = 999999.99
internal_test_count = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_float'] == 999999.99].shape[0]
print(f"Number of completed orders with revenue = 999999.99: {internal_test_count}")

# Total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_float'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}")"}
